title: Hardware No-Code
description: Hardware as no-code (hn arc, HARDWARE_NOCODE_PLAN.md; D-hn-1..6 ruled 2026-10-03): ONE no-code model across frontend, backend and hardware. A HardwareSolution ties a backend SolutionDefinition to a cmod CGraph (the hardware SUBGRAPH, D-hn-1), the board or twin it targets, the hw-interface (a grpcbridge HardwareInterfaceBinding, the device-backend split point) and its configured displays. The placement rule derives where every node runs (board | twin | bridge | backend | browser) and REFUSES a Python node on the device side (RULE 2); hn-split renders the board half through cmod-glue (unchanged, byte-identical firmware) and the backend half as its own SolutionDefinition. Node kinds HardwareSubgraph / HardwareInterface / CAtom reach the ONE canvas's palette as data from GET /stateSpaceClasses (D-hn-2). firmware_runtime (bare-c | freertos | esp-idf | zephyr) is the person's knob; the runtime suggestion is shown with evidence, never applied (D-hn-3). hn-0: the split app uno-temp-split (variant h over the existing UNO peripheral, variant b) proven on the simavr twin.

engines.name: make
engines.note: pol hwnocode build only: make ALONE in the rendered board half, through cmod's engines seam (= the board engines seam: BOARD_ENGINES_URL -> local binary -> prf-board-engines:trixie -> topology board.engines -> refusal); placement, the split, the suggestion and the backend half need no engine
